citation: Sorola S, Hyrylä V, Eronen T, Kupari S, Venojärvi M, Tikkanen H, et al. Orthostatic test shows higher systolic blood pressure and sympathetic response in uncomplicated type 1 diabetes patients with normal V̇O2max vs. healthy controls. Clin Auton Res. 2024;35(3):381-391.
protocol: Orthostatic test: 5 min supine rest, then 5-s table tilt to 70 degrees and 5 min upright. BP at the end of the supine rest, immediately after the tilt and at upright marks. HR in the supine rest is the 5-min baseline.
population: Healthy controls n=31 (15 women, 16 men), age 33 +/- 7 y, BMI 24.2 +/- 3.1; printed beside a type 1 diabetes group (n=14), which is not used here.
note: Table 4 BP is mean +/- SD per the paper; Table 3 HR is median (25th; 75th) only, so it cannot be pooled as a mean. Use the control column only.
